categories.claude-1.16: Content Claude added in 1.16.0 (/lua-audit). The parity branch was cut against Claude 1.15.0, so the kit's one canonical source is ahead of it.
categories.canonical-newer: The kit ships one copy of shared code. The Codex tree carried an older copy; the kit emits the canonical (newer) one, as the scope decides for credentials.mjs and the MCP server.
categories.tests-superset: The kit runs the canonical (Claude) test suites on every host. The Codex copies were older subsets of them; the generated tree passes the full suites.
categories.host-runtime: Scope step 4: lib/hook-runtime.mjs becomes the multi-host runtime over lib/host.mjs (resolveHost() and the three protocol emitters), replacing the isCursorRuntime branch.
categories.tokenizer-verbatim: Parity clause 1: every adapter's tokenizer is byte-identical to core's. The Codex copy differed only in three comment sentences that name Claude Code.
categories.stale-dropped: Unreferenced v1.0.0 leftovers superseded by rules/*.mdc.
categories.parity-bug-fixed: A bug in the parity tree that the generator does not reproduce. Listed in NOTES.md.
categories.kit-fix: A bug fixed in the kit's canonical source after the parity branch; the live plugins are sunset and never patched.
categories.kit-consistency: One canonical value or rule for every host, decided in the kit (see NOTES.md).
